review_findings_closed: 1 reimport identity TOCTOU: private staging copy hashed and imported as one byte stream, then the created SDK row is re-read through exr_library_source and compared before any mapping is written; a wrong row is deleted again. PDF keeps the verified copy as originals/<sha>.orig and only that book's removal deletes it.

2 strict bounded intent parser: exact EOF, fixed field set and order, single occurrence, decimal-only values without sign/suffix/overflow, 1..8 ids including mapped, checksum over every preceding byte; a damaged record leaves the file and both databases byte-identical.
3 no-follow state directory and exclusive temporary files; per-book cleanup (<sha>.orig, <sha>.open) replaces clearing the directory, so another book's private original survives.

4 reentrancy: remove/recover/reimport return READER_LD_BUSY when called from after_stage, is_busy or the cancellation hook and change nothing; reader_ld_pending stays read-only and reports the committed stage.

5 nine-format matrix (txt/html/fb2/epub/docx/rtf/mobi/pdf/cbz) with remove, exact reimport and second remove, plus PDF private-original lifetime and cross-book isolation using the real public PDF original.

6 retained-original publication moved before import and mapping: a blocked publication (target is a real directory, or a locked file on Windows) returns IO with no SDK row, no mapping and byte-identical databases, and a plain retry succeeds (reimport_publish_blocked).

7 bounded staging copy: the book length is checked against the effective installed-sideload ceiling before anything is copied, the file is size-checked once as a fast path, and the copy loop enforces the expected original length as a hard write bound, so a growing file can never exceed it (reimport_over_ceiling, reimport_longer_file).

8 documentation corrected from source: src/library.c import_file_pdf -> stream_import_values -> stream_insert stores the whole original in the SDK books.source BLOB and maps the path only while importing, so reading does not depend on the retained file; originals/<sha>.orig is this module's own recovery artifact.
